Indicator Title: Information on contract and license allocation is public
Indicator Question: There is a public overview of awards and transfers of oil, gas and mining licenses, including statutory procedures and whether they are followed
Indicator Desription: To meet this benchmark, information on all contract and license awards and transfers since 2021 must be disclosed, including: 1) Description of the process for transfers or awards, 2) Technical and financial criteria used, 3) Recipients of the license, and 4) Material deviations from applicable frameworks. Any gaps must be identified and explained. Where licenses are awarded through a bidding process, applicants and bid criteria must be disclosed. Meeting this benchmark corresponds to fully meeting the EITI Standard (90 points out of 100). Partial scores correspond to significant implementation (at least 70 points). No score is given for limited or poor implementation (below 70 points).
